blocks.text: THE ALLIES LANDED IN NORMANDY.|HITLER WAS STILL WAITING AT CALAIS.|JOHNNY HAD SAID NOTHING.
HE SEARCHED FOR JOHNNY IN EVERY|RUIN. HE NEVER FOUND HIM.
THE BRITISH DECORATED HIM. THE CEREMONY|WAS HELD, AS IT SHOULD BE, AT THE RITZ BAR.
THIRTY YEARS LATER, HE TOLD|IT ALL IN HIS MEMOIRS. ALMOST ALL.
HE DIED IN 1981 IN OPIO, IN THE HILLS ABOVE NICE.|THE PAPERS CALLED HIM “THE REAL JAMES BOND”.
